source: USGS 3DEP lidar: south of ~38.4163 N the 2018 UT_Southern_QL1 OPR 0.5 m DEM (as mdrs_area_lidar2018_0p5m.json); north of it a 0.5 m grid of class-2 ground returns from the 2020 UT_StatewideSouth_2020_A20 point clouds (flown 2020-07-25..29, Leica TerrainMapper; 9.2 ground returns/m2 inside the survey's coverage, 8.9-9.5 per tile, measured 2026-10-10 on the 6 tiles listed)
rebuilt: 2026-10-10: tools/usgs_lidar.py (recipe route_area) makes this raster from the files listed here with its content_sha256 in rasters.json, on osx-arm64 with GDAL 3.13.3, PROJ 9.8.1, OpenCV 4.13.0, numpy 2.5.3, laspy 2.7.0
source_tiles_2018_opr_note: the 5 of mdrs_area_lidar2018_0p5m.json's 11 tiles that intersect the UTM grid 518000-521000 E x 4250000-4254000 N (the tiles do not overlap); the run of 2026-10-06 put all 11 in its VRT, and its nearest resampling onto that grid copies these tiles' pixels, so the other 6 cannot change one
processing: 2020: mean of ground returns per 0.5 m UTM cell (inside the survey's coverage, the 4 m blocks with a return closed by one block: 2.30 returns per cell on average and 7.6 % of the cells empty, measured 2026-10-10 on the 6 tiles listed), the empty cells filled by normalized Gaussian interpolation, sigma 0.35 m for 98 % of them and up to 3 m for the rest; 2018 and 2020 feathered by distance to each survey's edge (they differ by +1.0 cm median, 2.8 cm std on flat ground); gdalwarp bilinear to EPSG:4326 0.5 m grid on the route_area_3dep.tif column lattice; horizontal datum shift below
source_map: route_area_lidar_0p5m_source.tif (uint8, same grid): 1 = 2018 OPR, 2 = 2020 lidar, 3 = blend, 4 = 3DEP 1 m fill (none inside these bounds)

datum_shift_applied.why: PROJ's default EPSG:6341 (NAD83(2011) UTM 12N) -> EPSG:4326 is a null datum transformation; the 3DEP and NAIP ImageServers apply a real NAD83(2011)->WGS84 shift. Measured by phase correlation of hillshades against mdrs_area_3dep.tif in 4 windows (spread 0.03 m E, 0.05 m N) and applied so this file lines up with route_area_3dep.tif / mdrs_area_3dep.tif / *_naip2024.tif. Residual after the shift: <= 0.16 m in 10 test windows. For comparison PROJ's time-dependent 'ITRF2014 to NAD83(2011)' gives -1.30 m E, +0.46 m N at epoch 2018.3.

check: minus route_area_3dep.tif at 50k random points: mean -0.001 m, std 0.057 m, p1/p99 -0.125/+0.124 m; residual horizontal offset <= 0.16 m
